# JPEG XL fixtures

`gray.jxl`, `p3.jxl`, `animation.jxl`, `auxiliary.jxl` and `oversized.jxl` are synthetic Lolly fixtures, MPL-2.0, generated by `scripts/jxl/fixtures.cc` against the pinned libjxl 0.12.0 build. Build the `jxl-fixtures` CMake target, run `node jxl-fixtures.cjs <name>` and decode the emitted hexadecimal bytes. They cover grayscale, Display P3, animation, an extra depth channel and an excessive edge length.

`pq-gradient.jxl` is the unchanged `jxl/pq_gradient.jxl` from libjxl/testdata commit `73695d303670c90e4d506ea89d9901b081385089`, by the libjxl contributors, under CC BY 4.0. The upstream license is included as `LICENSE.pq-gradient`. Source: https://github.com/libjxl/testdata/blob/73695d303670c90e4d506ea89d9901b081385089/jxl/pq_gradient.jxl . It is a 16-bit grayscale PQ ramp with a declared 10,000-nit intensity target.
